latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of cn-stock-market-shanghai-shenzhen skill.
- Provides access to China A-share (Shanghai/SH and Shenzhen/SZ) market data.
- Uses OneKey Gateway and FinanceAgent for data retrieval.
- Requires a OneKey Gateway API key for authentication.
- Supports CLI and HTTP (curl) usage for querying stock symbols with SH/SZ prefixes.
- Returns stock quote data in JSON format.
